token_amazon = apis.amazon.login(username='jes.mill@gmail.com', password=[p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='amazon'][0])['access_token']

cart = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=token_amazon)
print('cart:', cart)

# Search products for the two recommendations
rec_oxo = "OXO Good Grips Salad Spinner"
rec_escali = "Escali Primo P115C Precision Kitchen Food Scale"

api = apis.amazon.search_products


def search_all(query):
    all_items=[]
    page=0
    while True:
        items = apis.amazon.search_products(query=query, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
        print('query', query, 'page', page, 'count', len(items))
        if not items:
            break
        all_items.extend(items)
        page += 1
        if page>20:
            break
    return all_items

oxo_items = search_all(rec_oxo)
escali_items = search_all(rec_escali)

print('total oxo items', len(oxo_items))
print('sample oxo names/prices', [(it.get('name'), it.get('price')) for it in oxo_items[:5]])
print('total escali items', len(escali_items))
print('sample escali names/prices', [(it.get('name'), it.get('price')) for it in escali_items[:5]])

# Try to pick best match: exact name contains key model parts
# For escali: prefer names containing 'P115C'
# For oxo: David said Salad Spinner; but task is food scale. We'll attempt to find items containing 'Scale' or 'Food Scale' as well; else fall back to exact phrase match.

def pick_best_escali(items):
    cand = [it for it in items if 'P115C' in (it.get('name') or '') or 'P115C' in (it.get('description') or '')]
    if not cand:
        cand = items
    # choose cheapest
    cand_sorted = sorted(cand, key=lambda x: x.get('price', float('inf')))
    return cand_sorted[:5]


def pick_best_oxo(items):
    # exact phrase might not exist; choose items with 'Salad' or 'Spinner' OR 'Scale'/'Food Scale'
    cand = [it for it in items if any(k.lower() in (it.get('name','')+ ' '+ it.get('description','')).lower() for k in ['salad','spinner','food scale','scale'])]
    if not cand:
        cand = items
    cand_sorted = sorted(cand, key=lambda x: x.get('price', float('inf')))
    return cand_sorted[:5]

print('best escali candidates:', [(c.get('product_id'), c.get('name'), c.get('price')) for c in pick_best_escali(escali_items)])
print('best oxo candidates:', [(c.get('product_id'), c.get('name'), c.get('price')) for c in pick_best_oxo(oxo_items)])

# Prepare and update cart: clear existing items and add the recommended food scale
amz_pwd = [p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='amazon'][0]
amz_token = apis.amazon.login(username='jes.mill@gmail.com', password=amz_pwd)['access_token']

recommended = {
    'escali': {'product_id': 2691, 'name': 'Escali Primo P115C Precision Kitchen Food Scale'},
    'oxo': {'product_id': 2695, 'name': 'OXO Good Grips Salad Spinner'}
}
# Compare prices to follow David's instruction to pick the cheaper one
escali_price = apis.amazon.show_product(product_id=recommended['escali']['product_id'])['price']
oxo_price = apis.amazon.show_product(product_id=recommended['oxo']['product_id'])['price']

chosen = recommended['escali'] if escali_price <= oxo_price else recommended['oxo']
print('escali_price:', escali_price, 'oxo_price:', oxo_price)
print('chosen:', chosen)

# Clear cart first (use add_product_to_cart's clear_cart_first)
resp_add = apis.amazon.add_product_to_cart(product_id=chosen['product_id'], access_token=amz_token, quantity=1, clear_cart_first=True)
print('add_product_to_cart response:', resp_add)

cart_after = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=amz_token)
print('cart_after total_cost:', cart_after.get('total_cost'))
print('cart_after items:', [(it['product_id'], it['product_name'], it['quantity'], it['price']) for it in cart_after['cart_items']])

# Fetch available payment cards and addresses to select for checkout
cards = apis.amazon.show_payment_cards(access_token=amz_token)
addrs = apis.amazon.show_addresses(access_token=amz_token)
print('payment_cards:', [(c['payment_card_id'], c['card_name'], c['owner_name'], c.get('expiry_year'), c.get('expiry_month')) for c in cards])
print('addresses:', [(a['address_id'], a['name'], a.get('city'), a.get('state'), a.get('zip_code')) for a in addrs])

# Pick Visa + Home if available; otherwise pick first
visa = next((c for c in cards if str(c.get('card_name','')).lower()=='visa'), None)
home = next((a for a in addrs if str(a.get('name','')).lower()=='home'), None)

payment_card_id = visa['payment_card_id'] if visa else cards[0]['payment_card_id']
address_id = home['address_id'] if home else addrs[0]['address_id']
print('selected payment_card_id:', payment_card_id)
print('selected address_id:', address_id)

# IRREVERSIBLE ACTION PRE-VERIFICATION for placing the order
amz_pwd = [p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='amazon'][0]
amz_token = apis.amazon.login(username='jes.mill@gmail.com', password=amz_pwd)['access_token']

# Source from David's phone message (verification)
source_messages = [
    ('2023-05-18T08:13:46', "Yes, buy one of 'OXO Good Grips Salad Spinner' or 'Escali Primo P115C Precision Kitchen Food Scale' on amazon. They both are very similar, so pick the cheaper one. I have used both and am super happy with them.")
]

chosen_product_id = 2691  # chosen earlier by cheaper price
chosen_product_name = apis.amazon.show_product(product_id=chosen_product_id)['name']
chosen_price = apis.amazon.show_product(product_id=chosen_product_id)['price']

cart = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=amz_token)

# selection for payment & address (re-pick deterministically)
cards = apis.amazon.show_payment_cards(access_token=amz_token)
addrs = apis.amazon.show_addresses(access_token=amz_token)
visa = next((c for c in cards if str(c.get('card_name','')).lower()=='visa'), None)
home = next((a for a in addrs if str(a.get('name','')).lower()=='home'), None)
payment_card_id = visa['payment_card_id'] if visa else cards[0]['payment_card_id']
address_id = home['address_id'] if home else addrs[0]['address_id']

print('Task asks:', "Buy me a food scale as David recommended in his phone message")
print('\nVerification table:')
print('Source line time | David recommendation item | Selected item')
for ts, text in source_messages:
    if 'Escali Primo P115C Precision Kitchen Food Scale' in text:
        rec_item = 'Escali Primo P115C Precision Kitchen Food Scale'
    else:
        rec_item = 'OXO Good Grips Salad Spinner'
    print(ts, '|', rec_item, '|', f"{chosen_product_name} (product_id={chosen_product_id})")

print('\nComputed checkout payload:')
print('cart_items:', [(it['product_id'], it['product_name'], it['quantity'], it['price']) for it in cart['cart_items']])
print('cart_total_cost:', cart.get('total_cost'))
print('chosen_price:', chosen_price)
print('payment_card_id:', payment_card_id)
print('address_id:', address_id)
